name: DingTalk Workspace
description: Use DingTalk as the current authorized user to manage to-dos, messages, Drive files, and documents.
installationSteps: Install the plugin, then ask a Bot to install DingTalk Workspace CLI on the selected Computer.
Check the selected Computer with the dingtalk-setup status command, then complete device-flow authorization if needed. Your organization must enable CLI access first.

For migration, export a DWS portable auth bundle on the source Computer, transfer it once with CopyToBox, and import it on the target Computer; the target verifies the login and removes its one-time bundle.
Use the DingTalk workspace skill for to-dos, messages, Drive, and document operations. Other enabled Bots on the same Computer can use this login; uninstalling removes skills, not CLI credentials.

skills.name: dingtalk-setup
skills.description: Install the pinned DingTalk Workspace CLI, manage the selected Computer's login state, import or export a one-time portable auth bundle, and diagnose connection failures.

skills.name: dingtalk-workspace
skills.description: Use the current authorized DingTalk user to query and handle to-dos, messages, personal IM events, Drive files, and DingTalk documents.
